name: coupling
description: Iteratively reduces coupling in documents, code modules, applications, or repositories: scans for change-transmitting dependencies against a coupling model (strength ladder, connascence, volatility), verifies each finding, applies a budgeted batch of safe behavior-preserving reductions, and keeps a ledger so structural candidates route to design and later runs resume. When a value changes, it finds and classifies every site stating it and converts setup sites to references.
